verdict.rationale: Alloy publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document and a public reference of 134 endpoints, covering evaluations, entities, events, and webhooks. Some information, such as Evaluation warnings, appears in both the API response and the dashboard. However, nothing documents that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and some actions, like re-enabling a disabled webhook, are described only as dashboard settings. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of workflow/Journey configuration, SSO/SCIM and webhook settings, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Alloy serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the docs origin
The ReadMe-hosted API reference (134 endpoint pages, publicly browsable)
the warnings section in the Evaluation API response and dashboard gives additional information about what data was missing
Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
